item.name: Black Fire
item.cardSummary: Long, high-scaling DoT from Crow that chews through shields while stacking burn pressure over a full 12-second window.
item.effect: Deals 2x of the applying unit's damage across 12 ticks over 12 seconds. Crow's kit also uses Black Fire ticks to damage shields and stack Black Fire on shielded enemies in range.
item.stackRules: Same unit cannot stack identical DoT on one enemy; different units can apply the same DoT together.

item.name: Bleed
item.cardSummary: Mid-length DoT used by several physical and dark kits; strong for sustained chip damage that scales with the applier's damage.
item.effect: Deals 0.65x of the applying unit's damage across 6 ticks over 6 seconds.
item.stackRules: Same unit cannot stack identical DoT on one enemy; different units can apply the same DoT together.
item.exampleUnits: Crimson (Brother), Crimson, Cursed Student (True Love), Cursed Student, Greed, Bounty Hunter

item.name: Burn
item.cardSummary: Short flame DoT that partners with Hollow's Austere Flames conversions and Flame Emperor spread tools.
item.effect: Deals 1x of the applying unit's damage across 4 ticks over 4 seconds.
item.stackRules: Same unit cannot stack identical DoT on one enemy; different units can apply the same DoT together.
item.exampleUnits: Flame Emperor (Reincarnate), Flame Emperor, Demon Cyborg

item.name: Austere Flames
item.cardSummary: Stronger short DoT often converted from Burn by Hollow, rewarding burn setups with a heavier follow-up flame tick package.
item.effect: Deals 0.75x of the applying unit's damage across 4 ticks over 4 seconds.
item.stackRules: Same unit cannot stack identical DoT on one enemy; different units can apply the same DoT together.

item.name: Mana Burn
item.cardSummary: Longer, lighter DoT from Elf Mage that stretches chip damage across eight ticks.
item.effect: Deals 0.5x of the applying unit's damage across 8 ticks over 8 seconds.
item.stackRules: Same unit cannot stack identical DoT on one enemy; different units can apply the same DoT together.

item.name: Slow
item.cardSummary: Halves enemy path speed for five seconds so DPS units get more hits before a target reaches the base.
item.effect: Reduces enemy movement speed to 0.5x for 5 seconds.
item.stackRules: Soft crowd-control effects share a cooldown bracket and same-type soft CC conflicts on reapply.
item.exampleUnits: Salmon Sorcerer (Grade 1), Salmon Sorcerer, Ice Mage

item.name: Stagger
item.cardSummary: Interrupts actions and briefly delays movement, buying space without a full hard stop.
item.effect: Interrupts enemy actions and briefly delays movement for 4 seconds.
item.stackRules: Soft crowd-control effects share a cooldown bracket and same-type soft CC conflicts on reapply.
item.exampleUnits: Razorjaw (Hunter), Razorjaw, Salmon Sorcerer (Grade 1), Salmon Sorcerer

item.name: Dismembered
item.cardSummary: Permanent 15% movespeed cut from 8th Sword that sticks for the rest of the enemy's path.
item.effect: Permanently reduces enemy movement speed to 0.85x.
item.stackRules: Soft crowd-control family; same-type soft CC conflicts on reapply.

item.name: Freeze
item.cardSummary: Hard stop that freezes movement and actions for two seconds, giving high-damage units a clean damage window.
item.effect: Freezes the target, preventing movement and actions for 2 seconds.
item.stackRules: Hard crowd-control effects share a stricter cooldown bracket and same-type hard CC conflicts on reapply.

item.name: Rewind
item.cardSummary: Forces enemies backward along the path for three seconds, strong against bosses and fast movers up to the per-enemy cap.
item.effect: Forces the target to move backward along its path for 3 seconds.
item.stackRules: Hard CC bracket. Max 10 applications per enemy.

item.name: Stun
item.cardSummary: Full hard stop for two seconds with a shorter cooldown than Freeze, common on Shadow and String Demon kits.
item.effect: Prevents all actions and movement for 2 seconds.
item.stackRules: Hard crowd-control effects share a stricter cooldown bracket and same-type hard CC conflicts on reapply.
item.exampleUnits: Shadow (Divine), Shadow, String Demon (Awakened), String Demon

item.name: Shadow Rewind
item.cardSummary: Teleport-style rewind that snaps enemies toward the start of the path, limited to three uses per enemy.
item.effect: Teleports enemies back toward the enemy base / start of the path.
item.stackRules: Hard CC family. Max 3 applications per enemy.

item.name: Illusion
item.cardSummary: Crow mark that stores damage dealt during the window, then releases a reduced-strength AoE when the mark ends.
item.effect: Mark from Crow's Illusion. Lasts about 12 seconds while damage from that unit is stored, then releases about 25% of the stored damage in a small AoE when Illusion ends.
item.stackRules: Persistent mark tied to Crow's kit until the store window ends.

item.name: True Saint Mark
item.cardSummary: Persistent True Saint tag that enables extra kit triggers rather than dealing damage on its own.
item.effect: Persistent mark applied by True Saint that can trigger additional unit abilities.
item.stackRules: Persistent mark used by True Saint kit triggers.

item.name: Puppet Mark
item.cardSummary: Teamwide support mark that makes the target take more damage from every source, capped per enemy.
item.effect: Marked enemies take 20% increased incoming damage.
item.stackRules: Persistent mark. Max 3 applications per enemy.

item.name: Crimson Mark
item.cardSummary: Crimson kit mark that detonates after five seconds for a share of the unit's current damage and can leave path pools.
item.effect: Marked enemies Crimson Explode after 5 seconds, taking 15% of the applying unit's current damage.
item.stackRules: Persistent mark tied to Crimson's explosion passive until it detonates.

item.name: Cocoon
item.cardSummary: String Demon misc effect that wraps a target and applies Stun, bridging crowd-control into a trap-style package.
item.effect: Traps an enemy in a cocoon and applies Stun.
item.stackRules: Miscellaneous status effect; Stun portion follows hard CC stun rules.
